📌 Key points要点

⭐ Must know必须记住
  • am/n=(na​)m: bottom of the exponent = root, top = power.am/n=(na​)m：指数的分母是开方次数，分子是乘方次数。
  • By hand, take the root first: 272/3=32=9.手算先开方，数字小：272/3=32=9。
  • Negative exponent = reciprocal, never a negative answer: 16−1/2=41​.负指数＝倒数，结果不会变负：16−1/2=41​。

💡 What could 82/3 possibly mean? Two-thirds of a multiplication sounds impossible — but it is just a cube root followed by a square, and it equals exactly 4.82/3 到底是什么意思？「乘三分之二次」听起来不可能——意思是先开立方再平方，结果正好是 4。

  1. The denominator of the exponent is the root; the numerator is the power: am/n=(na​)m=nam​.指数的分母是开几次方，分子是几次幂：am/n=(na​)m=nam​。
  2. Take the root FIRST when evaluating by hand — the numbers stay small: 272/3=32=9 (not 3729​).手算时先开方——数字保持很小：272/3=32=9（不用算 3729​）。
  3. A negative rational exponent still means reciprocal: 16−3/4=163/41​=81​. The sign of the exponent never makes the answer negative.负的分数指数仍然表示取倒数：16−3/4=163/41​=81​。指数是负的，结果并不会变成负数。
  4. All the exponent laws still work with fractions — you just add, subtract and multiply fractions.所有指数律对分数指数照样成立——只是变成分数的加、减、乘。

🧮 Key formulas关键公式

an1​=na​,anm​=(na​)m=nam​
Rational exponent ↔ radical分数指数与根式互化
a−nm​=anm​1​
Negative rational exponent (a=0)负分数指数（a=0）
🎯 Test tip考试提示
Non-calculator sections test am/n with nice bases (8, 16, 27, 32, 64, 81, 125). Memorize small powers of 2, 3 and 5 — then every question is "root, power, flip if negative".不许用计算器的部分常考底数是 8、16、27、32、64、81、125 的 am/n。记住 2、3、5 的小次幂，每道题就是「开方、乘方、负指数就倒过来」。

🧭 How to get started怎么入手

Ask yourself these five, in order, before writing anything. Every worked example on this page is labelled with them.动笔之前，按顺序问自己这五个问题。本页每道例题的步骤都标了它们。

  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Circle three things: the base, the denominator of the exponent (the root) and the numerator (the power). Note any minus sign in the exponent.圈出三样东西：底数、指数的分母（开几次方）、指数的分子（几次幂）。指数上有负号也标出来。
  2. 🎯 Asked求什么
    Is it "evaluate" (a number), "simplify" (one power of each variable, positive exponents) or "write as a radical"? The answer form depends on it.题目要的是「求值」（一个数）、「化简」（每个字母只剩一个幂，指数为正），还是「写成根式」？答案形式由它决定。
  3. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    Write the base as a power of a small number: 64=26=43=82. Seeing that list tells you which root comes out clean.把底数写成小数字的幂：64=26=43=82。看着这串式子，就知道开几次方能开得干净。
  4. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Flip first if the exponent is negative, then take the root, then the power. For variables, use the exponent laws and add/subtract the fractions.指数是负的就先翻转（取倒数），再开方，再乘方。字母部分用指数律，对分数指数做加减。
  5. ✅ Check检验
    A negative exponent never makes the answer negative. Check backwards: raise your answer to the reciprocal power and see if you get the start again.负指数不会让结果变负。倒推检验：把答案取倒数次幂，看能不能回到原来的数。

🧱 Prerequisite check先修检查

4 quick Grade 9–10 questions, about 3 minutes. Miss one and a 5-minute repair card opens right there; fix it, then carry on.4 道九、十年级小题，约 3 分钟。错了就在原地打开 5 分钟补救卡，补好再继续。

1Exponent rules (product, quotient, power)指数运算法则（同底乘、除、乘方）
Simplify x3⋅x4.化简 x3⋅x4。

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Exponent rules (product, quotient, power)指数运算法则（同底乘、除、乘方） (Grade年级 9)
Same base: multiply → ADD exponents (x3x4=x7); divide → SUBTRACT (x7÷x2=x5); power of a power → MULTIPLY ((x3)2=x6). A power of a product hits every factor: (2x)3=8x3.同底数：相乘→指数相加（x3x4=x7）；相除→指数相减（x7÷x2=x5）；幂的乘方→指数相乘（(x3)2=x6）。积的乘方每个因数都要乘方：(2x)3=8x3。
  1. (3x2)2⋅x=9x4⋅x=9x5.(3x2)2⋅x=9x4⋅x=9x5。
  2. 2x26x5​=3x3 (divide the numbers, subtract the exponents).2x26x5​=3x3（系数相除，指数相减）。
Try one:试一道：
Simplify 4x(2x3)2​.化简 4x(2x3)2​。

2Perfect squares and square roots完全平方数与平方根
What is 364​?364​ 等于多少？

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Perfect squares and square roots完全平方数与平方根 (Grade年级 8–10)
Know the squares 1,4,9,…,225. ab​=a​b​, so 50​=25​2​=52​. But a+b​=a​+b​: 9+16​=5, not 7. x​ means the non-negative root.记住 1,4,9,…,225 这些平方数。ab​=a​b​，所以 50​=25​2​=52​。但 a+b​=a​+b​：9+16​=5，不是 7。x​ 表示非负的那个根。
  1. 72​: biggest square factor is 36 → 62​.72​：最大的平方因数是 36 → 62​。
  2. x2=49 has TWO answers x=±7, but 49​=7 only.x2=49 有两个解 x=±7，但 49​ 只等于 7。
Try one:试一道：
Which is equal to 48​?哪个等于 48​？

3Fractions: add, subtract, multiply, divide分数的四则运算
Work out 32​+41​.计算 32​+41​。

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Fractions: add, subtract, multiply, divide分数的四则运算 (Grade年级 7–9)
Add or subtract only with a common denominator: 21​+31​=63​+62​=65​. Multiply straight across. Divide = multiply by the reciprocal (flip the second fraction).加减必须先通分：21​+31​=63​+62​=65​。乘法分子乘分子、分母乘分母。除以一个分数＝乘它的倒数（把第二个分数倒过来）。
  1. 32​−41​: common denominator 12 → 128​−123​=125​.32​−41​：公分母 12 → 128​−123​=125​。
  2. 43​÷89​=43​⋅98​=3624​=32​.43​÷89​=43​⋅98​=3624​=32​。
  3. Never add denominators: 21​+31​=52​.分母不能相加：21​+31​=52​。
Try one:试一道：
Simplify 65​−41​.化简 65​−41​。

4Exponent rules (product, quotient, power)指数运算法则（同底乘、除、乘方）
What is 2−3?2−3 等于多少？

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Exponent rules (product, quotient, power)指数运算法则（同底乘、除、乘方） (Grade年级 9)
Same base: multiply → ADD exponents (x3x4=x7); divide → SUBTRACT (x7÷x2=x5); power of a power → MULTIPLY ((x3)2=x6). A power of a product hits every factor: (2x)3=8x3.同底数：相乘→指数相加（x3x4=x7）；相除→指数相减（x7÷x2=x5）；幂的乘方→指数相乘（(x3)2=x6）。积的乘方每个因数都要乘方：(2x)3=8x3。
  1. (3x2)2⋅x=9x4⋅x=9x5.(3x2)2⋅x=9x4⋅x=9x5。
  2. 2x26x5​=3x3 (divide the numbers, subtract the exponents).2x26x5​=3x3（系数相除，指数相减）。
Try one:试一道：
Simplify 4x(2x3)2​.化简 4x(2x3)2​。

🪜 Worked → fill in → your turn例题 → 填空 → 自己做

Three versions of one idea: read a full solution, then finish a half-done one, then do one yourself with hints you open one at a time.同一个思路的三个版本：先看完整解答，再补全半成品，最后自己做——提示一次只开一个。

① Worked example — read it完整例题——看懂
Evaluate 64−2/3 without a calculator.不用计算器，求 64−2/3。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Base 64, root 3 (denominator), power 2 (numerator), and a minus sign.底数 64，开 3 次方（分母），2 次幂（分子），还有一个负号。
  2. 🎯 Asked求什么
    A single number. It must be positive.要一个数，而且一定是正数。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Flip: 64−2/3=642/31​.翻转：64−2/3=642/31​。
  4. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Root first: 364​=4. Then power: 42=16. So 161​.先开方：364​=4；再乘方：42=16。所以是 161​。
  5. ✅ Check检验
    Backwards: 163/2=(16​)3=64, so (161​)−3/2=64 ✓.倒推：163/2=(16​)3=64，所以 (161​)−3/2=64 ✓。
✔
161​
② Same idea — you fill the gaps同一思路——你来补空
Evaluate 81−3/4 without a calculator.不用计算器，求 81−3/4。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Base 81, root 4, power 3, minus sign.底数 81，开 4 次方，3 次幂，有负号。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Flip: 81−3/4=813/41​.翻转：81−3/4=813/41​。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    ✍️
    Your turn: take the 4th root of 81, then cube it.轮到你：先求 81 的 4 次方根，再立方。
    481​=3 (because 34=81), and 33=27. So 271​.481​=3（因为 34=81），33=27。所以是 271​。
  4. ✅ Check检验
    ✍️
    Your turn: is your answer positive? Check it backwards.轮到你：答案是正数吗？倒推检验一下。
    Positive ✓. 274/3=(327​)4=34=81 ✓.是正数 ✓。274/3=(327​)4=34=81 ✓。
Answer答案
271​
③ Your turn — on paper first轮到你——先在纸上做
Evaluate (1258​)−2/3 without a calculator.不用计算器，求 (1258​)−2/3。
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    A negative exponent on a fraction: just turn the fraction upside down.分数的负指数：把分数上下倒过来就行。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Now you have (8125​)2/3. Cube-root the top and the bottom separately.现在是 (8125​)2/3。分子分母分别开立方。
  3. ✅ Check检验
    You should get 25​ after the root. Square it, and make sure the answer is positive.开方后应得 25​。再平方，确认结果是正数。
425​
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Flip: (8125​)2/3.翻转：(8125​)2/3。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Root: 3125​=5, 38​=2, so 25​. Power: (25​)2=425​.开方：3125​=5，38​=2，得 25​。乘方：(25​)2=425​。
  3. ✅ Check检验
    Positive, and bigger than 1 because the original fraction was smaller than 1 and the exponent was negative ✓.是正数；原分数小于 1、指数为负，所以结果大于 1 ✓。

Example 3例 3L3 Connect会用2 methods种解法
Simplify (x−1/28x3/4​)2/3, x>0. Give the answer with a positive exponent, then as a radical.化简 (x−1/28x3/4​)2/3（x>0），先用正指数表示，再写成根式。
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Inside, subtract exponents: 43​−(−21​)=43​+42​=45​. So the bracket is 8x5/4.括号内指数相减：43​−(−21​)=43​+42​=45​，括号变成 8x5/4。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Raise each factor to 32​: 82/3=(38​)2=4 and x45​⋅32​=x10/12=x5/6.每个因数都乘 32​ 次方：82/3=(38​)2=4，x45​⋅32​=x10/12=x5/6。
  3. 🎯 Asked求什么
    Result: 4x5/6=46x5​.结果：4x5/6=46x5​。
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Apply 32​ to top and bottom separately: top 82/3x43​⋅32​=4x1/2; bottom x−21​⋅32​=x−1/3.把 32​ 次方分别作用到分子和分母：分子 82/3x43​⋅32​=4x1/2；分母 x−21​⋅32​=x−1/3。
  2. ✅ Check检验
    Divide: 4x21​−(−31​)=4x63​+62​=4x5/6. Same answer.相除：4x21​−(−31​)=4x63​+62​=4x5/6，答案相同。
Answer答案
4x5/6=46x5​

🔍 Common mistakes常见错误

Someone made each of these. Tap the line where it first goes wrong.每道题都有人这样做过。点出第一处出错的那一行。

1Reading the root and the power the wrong way round把开方和乘方读反了
Evaluate 642/3.求 642/3。

🧠 The 2 on top looked like "square root". But the DENOMINATOR is the root: 32​ means cube root, then square.分子上的 2 看着像「开平方」。其实分母才是开方次数：32​ 表示先开立方，再平方。

🔧 364​=4, then 42=16.364​=4，再 42=16。

✔ 16

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Practice练习 1

2A negative exponent gives a negative answer以为负指数让结果变负
Evaluate 25−1/2.求 25−1/2。

🧠 The minus sign in an exponent means "take the reciprocal", not "make it negative". A positive base always gives a positive power.指数上的负号表示「取倒数」，不是「变成负数」。底数为正，幂永远为正。

🔧 25−1/2=251/21​=51​.25−1/2=251/21​=51​。

✔ 51​

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Check-up测评 Q1 B, Practice练习 2

3Multiplying the base by the exponent把底数和指数相乘
Evaluate 271/3.求 271/3。

🧠 An exponent is not a multiplier. 31​ as an exponent asks "what number cubed gives 27?"指数不是乘数。指数 31​ 问的是「哪个数立方等于 27」。

🔧 271/3=327​=3, since 33=27.271/3=327​=3，因为 33=27。

✔ 3

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Check-up测评 Q1 D

4Multiplying exponents when you should add them该把指数相加，却相乘了
Simplify x1/2⋅x1/4, x>0.化简 x1/2⋅x1/4（x>0）。

🧠 Fractions made the familiar rule feel new. Multiplying powers of the same base still means ADD the exponents; you multiply only for a power of a power.一碰到分数，熟悉的法则就忘了。同底数幂相乘仍然是指数「相加」；只有幂的乘方才是指数相乘。

🔧 21​+41​=42​+41​=43​, so x3/4.21​+41​=42​+41​=43​，所以是 x3/4。

✔ x3/4

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Check-up测评 Q2 B, Practice练习 3

5Raising only the variable, not the number in front只给字母乘方，漏了前面的数字
Simplify (16x8)3/4, x>0.化简 (16x8)3/4（x>0）。

🧠 The 16 looked like a plain coefficient that just comes along. But the bracket means every factor inside is raised to 43​.16 看起来像一个跟着走的系数。可是括号表示里面每个因数都要取 43​ 次方。

🔧 163/4=(416​)3=23=8, so 8x6.163/4=(416​)3=23=8，所以是 8x6。

✔ 8x6

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Practice练习 5

⚠️ Quick list速查

  • Flipping the fraction: a2/3 is the CUBE root squared, not the square root cubed.把分数指数读反：a2/3 是「开立方再平方」，不是「开平方再立方」。
  • Making the answer negative: 16−1/2=41​, not −4.把结果写成负数：16−1/2=41​，不是 −4。
  • Calculator brackets: 272/3 must be typed as 27^(2/3). Without brackets the calculator does 272÷3=243.计算器漏括号：272/3 要输入 27^(2/3)。不加括号会算成 272÷3=243。
  • Even root of a negative base: (−16)1/2 is not real, but (−8)1/3=−2 is fine (odd root).负底数开偶次方：(−16)1/2 不是实数；但 (−8)1/3=−2 没问题（奇次方根）。

💡 Why it works为什么成立

What happens when the power isn't a whole number? (Fractional Indices)
Eddie Woo · 10 min · ↗
Shows WHY the denominator is a root using only the product rule you already know — so a1/n=na​ stops being a rule to memorise. It only covers a1/n, not am/n, and says "indices" for exponents.只用你早就会的同底数相乘法则，讲清分母为什么是开方，a1/n=na​ 就不用死记了。它只讲 a1/n，不讲 am/n，而且把指数叫 indices。
⏩ From 0:00: he asks what "3 to the power one half" could even mean, then uses a1/2⋅a1/2=a1 to show it must be 3​; the same idea gives cube roots and 10th roots by 6:00. Stop around 10:00.从 0:00 开始：他先问「3 的二分之一次方」到底是什么，再用 a1/2⋅a1/2=a1 推出它一定是 3​；到 6:00 用同样的想法得到立方根、10 次方根。看到 10:00 左右即可。

🪜 Step by step一步一步

WCLN - Exponential Laws and Fractional Exponents
WCLN · 8 min · ↗
A BC (WCLN) lesson that does nothing but the fraction arithmetic inside exponent laws, slowly, with the common denominator written out every time — exactly where most marks are lost.BC 本地（WCLN）的课，只练指数律里的分数运算，每次都把通分写出来，速度慢——正是最容易丢分的地方。
⏩ From 0:00: product rule with x2/3⋅x5/2 (common denominator 6), then the power rule, power of a product (3:03) and quotient rule (3:49) — every exponent is a fraction. About 7 minutes.从 0:00 开始：先用 x2/3⋅x5/2 讲同底相乘（通分到 6），再讲幂的乘方、积的乘方（3:03）和同底相除（3:49）——每个指数都是分数。约 7 分钟。
How to Convert Rational Exponents to Radical Form & Evaluate (Fractional Exponents)
Mario's Math Tutoring · 10 min · ↗
He says out loud the question to ask for each root ("what number times itself four times is 16?") and why root-first keeps numbers small; the negative-exponent and negative-base cases are the two traps on tests.他把每次开方要问的话说出来（「哪个数自己乘四次等于 16？」），也讲了为什么先开方数字小；负指数和负底数正是考试的两个陷阱。
⏩ From 0:40: 82/3 done both ways (root first vs power first), then 163/4, 813/2, 125−2/3 (3:51, negative exponent), a negative base with an even root (6:56), and converting radicals back to exponents (10:46).从 0:40 开始：82/3 用两种顺序算（先开方与先乘方），接着 163/4、813/2、125−2/3（3:51，负指数）、偶次根下的负底数（6:56），最后把根式写回指数（10:46）。

🔍 Common mistakes常见错误

Common Mistakes to Avoid for Negative Rational Exponents Expressions
Anil Kumar · 5 min · ↗
Targets one specific trap — an exponent does not distribute over a plus sign — and teaches the habit of testing a rule with small numbers before trusting it.专门针对一个陷阱——指数不能分配到加号上——并教你一个习惯：先代小数字试，再相信一条规则。
⏩ From 0:00: two true-or-false statements such as (x1/3+y1/3)6=x2+y2; he shows they are false by putting in numbers like x=8, y=1 (2:18). About 5 minutes.从 0:00 开始：两道判断对错，比如 (x1/3+y1/3)6=x2+y2；他代入 x=8、y=1 这样的数说明它们是错的（2:18）。约 5 分钟。

🎯 Quiz测验

⚡ Quick checks — instant feedback快速检查——马上知道对不对

Type each answer and press Check. A wrong answer is not a mark against you: it comes back tomorrow, then in 3 days, a week and two weeks.写下答案按「提交」。答错不扣分：它会明天再出现，然后是 3 天、一周、两周后。 Mixed practice from all topics →各知识点混合练习 →

1. Evaluate 272/3.计算 272/3。
The exponent 2/3 is not 'two thirds of 27'. Denominator = root, numerator = power.指数 2/3 不是「27 的三分之二」。分母＝开几次方，分子＝几次幂。
You found the cube root but forgot the square (the numerator 2).你开了立方根，但漏了分子 2 的平方。

✔ 9

Cube root first: 327​=3, then square: 32=9.先开立方：327​=3，再平方：32=9。

2. Evaluate 16−1/4 (a fraction like 1/2 is fine).计算 16−1/4（可写分数如 1/2）。
A negative exponent is a reciprocal, not a negative number; and 416​=2 goes in the denominator.负指数是倒数，不是负数；416​=2 要放在分母。
You found the 4th root but skipped the reciprocal that the minus sign asks for.你求出了四次方根，但漏了负号要求的倒数。

✔ 21​

16−1/4=161/41​=416​1​=21​.16−1/4=161/41​=416​1​=21​。

3. Evaluate (81​)−2/3.计算 (81​)−2/3。
The minus sign flips the fraction 81​ to 8, so the answer is bigger than 1.负号把 81​ 翻成 8，所以答案比 1 大。

✔ 4

Flip: 82/3=(38​)2=22=4.先倒过来：82/3=(38​)2=22=4。

4. Simplify x1/2⋅x3/2 (type x^2 for x2).化简 x1/2⋅x3/2（x2 输入 x^2）。
Multiplying powers adds the exponents; it does not multiply them (21​⋅23​).同底数幂相乘是指数相加，不是相乘（21​⋅23​）。

✔ x2

Same base, multiply: add the exponents, 21​+23​=2.同底数相乘，指数相加：21​+23​=2。

5. Simplify (8x6)1/3 with no brackets (type 2x^2).化简 (8x6)1/3，不留括号（输入 2x^2）。
The cube root applies to the 8 as well: 38​=2.开立方对 8 也要做：38​=2。
The value is right only if it is written without brackets left to multiply out.只有把括号都展开成最简形式才算完成。

✔ 2∗x∗∗2

Apply 31​ to both factors: 81/3=2 and (x6)1/3=x2.31​ 次方作用在每个因子上：81/3=2，(x6)1/3=x2。

🗣️ Explain it back用自己的话讲一遍

In two sentences: what does 272/3 mean, and which part do you do first?用两句话说：272/3 是什么意思？先做哪一步？

The bottom number of the fraction is the root and the top number is the power: 272/3=(327​)2. Take the root first (it keeps the numbers small): 32=9.分数指数的分母是开几次方，分子是几次幂：272/3=(327​)2。先开根（数字小），再乘方：32=9。

💡 Key idea解题思路
Raise both sides to the reciprocal power 23​; the even root of the square brings in a ±.两边取倒数幂 23​；偶次根（平方）要带上 ±。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Reciprocal power: x=(±4)3 from x2/3=16 rewritten as 3x​=±4.倒数幂：由 x2/3=16 得 3x​=±4，所以 x=(±4)3。
  • Check both 64 and −64 in 3x2​=16.把 64 与 −64 代入 3x2​=16 检验。
How did it go?做得怎样？
8L4 Solve会想🌍 Modelling建模⚙️ Fluent procedures运算熟练🔍 Checking & reasoning检验与推理
Earthquake energy: the energy E released (in some units) is related to magnitude M by E=101.5M. For a magnitude-4 quake the energy is E4​=106. Show that a magnitude-6 quake releases 1000 times as much, and write the ratio of energies between magnitudes M+2 and M as a power of 10. Then find the magnitude whose energy is 104.5.地震能量：释放的能量 E（某种单位）与震级 M 的关系为 E=101.5M。4 级地震的能量是 E4​=106。证明 6 级地震释放的能量是 4 级的 1000 倍，并把震级 M+2 与 M 的能量比写成 10 的幂。再求能量为 104.5 的震级。
Divide 101.5(M+2) by 101.5M with the quotient law. For the last part set 1.5M=4.5.用除法法则计算 101.5(M+2) 除以 101.5M。最后一问令 1.5M=4.5。
Ratio =103=1000 for any M; the magnitude with E=104.5 is M=3.对任意 M，比值都是 103=1000；能量为 104.5 的震级是 M=3。
  1. Magnitude 6: E6​=109, and 109/106=103=1000.6 级：E6​=109，109/106=103=1000。
  2. General: 101.5M101.5(M+2)​=101.5M+3−1.5M=103, independent of M.一般情形：101.5M101.5(M+2)​=101.5M+3−1.5M=103，与 M 无关。
  3. 101.5M=104.5 gives 1.5M=4.5, so M=3.101.5M=104.5 得 1.5M=4.5，所以 M=3。
🎯 Goal考查目标
Use rational-exponent laws inside a real model to compare two quantities and solve for an exponent.在实际模型中用分数指数律比较两个量并解出指数。

Rational exponents分数指数Exponent laws (zero & negative)指数律（零指数与负指数）

💡 Key idea解题思路
A ratio of powers with the same base is a power of the exponent difference.同底数幂之比等于指数之差的幂。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Quotient law on the exponents.对指数用除法法则。
  • Test with numbers: M=2 and M=4 give 103 and 106, ratio 103; then confirm the pattern for general M.代数检验：M=2 与 M=4 得 103 与 106，比值 103；再推广到一般 M。
